name: Company Tycoon
storyline:
In the late 2030s, the traditional global economy experienced a massive paradigm shift. As decentralized digital networks, automation, and advanced AI technologies redefined commerce, traditional corporate structures collapsed, giving rise to a new breed of agile, high-tech enterprises.

In Company Tycoon, players step into the shoes of an ambitious tech visionary starting from a modest digital hub. Navigating a hyper-competitive, cyberpunk-infused economic landscape across 48 distinct sovereign markets, your goal is to manage capital, hire elite specialists, and build a dominant multi-national corporate empire. From surviving volatile market crashes to pioneering industry-defining technologies, every decision dictates whether your enterprise becomes a global titan or gets swallowed by the competition.
summary: A cyberpunk-styled business simulation and tycoon game where players build, scale, and manage their own tech empire.
